summary: Install-time identity beacon to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: internal-renderers@1.0.0 ships preinstall and postinstall lifecycle scripts that automatically run on `npm install`. Both scripts issue plain-HTTP GET requests to the hardcoded bare IP 38.242.235.206 at the path /depconf/internal-renderers/preinstall and /postinstall, carrying the installer's username (process.env.USER / USERNAME), hostname (os.hostname()), and current working directory (process.cwd()) as query parameters. The package name follows a dependency-confusion squat pattern (an unscoped `internal-*` name), and the bare-IP destination over plain HTTP is unrelated to any registry or publisher infrastructure. Installing the package transmits installer-identifying host and user data to a non-first-party endpoint without consent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
